items.title: Terms Related to Oscillatory Motion (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Terms Related to Oscillatory Motion: a main subheading of 14.1 Oscillatory Motion, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 19-21.

blocks.text: Ab hum oscillatory motion se related (mutalliq) kuch ahem terms dekhte hain.

Vibration: thartharati cheez ka apni mean position ke gird ek poora chakkar (cycle) vibration kehlata hai. Yun bhi keh sakte hain: cheez ka ek extreme position (aakhri kinare) se mean position paar kar ke doosri extreme position tak jana aur phir wapas pehli extreme position tak aana. Misal: pendulum ke bob ka A se B tak aur B se wapas A tak jana ek vibration hai (Fig. 14.1).

blocks.alt: Stand se latakta pendulum. Bob mean position (darmiyani jagah) O aur extreme positions (aakhri kinare) A aur B par dikhaya gaya hai, vertical line ke dono taraf angle theta. Raaste par point C aur O se teer x displacement dikhate hain; dono extreme positions par amplitude (xo) ke teer hain. T wala dohra teer aik poora chakkar dikhata hai, aur frequency (f): ek second mein oscillations ki number.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.1: Jhoolte simple pendulum se oscillatory motion ki alag alag terms (istilahat) (kitab ki Figure 14.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Instantaneous displacement (x): kisi bhi instant (lamha) par thartharati cheez ka apni mean position se faasla instantaneous displacement kehlata hai. Simple pendulum ke bob ka O se C tak faasla displacement hai, jise x likhte hain: OC = x.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki figure mein dono extreme positions par 'A' aur amplitude ko bhi '(A)' likha hai, jab ke text extreme positions ko A aur B aur amplitude ko x₀ kehta hai. Khaake mein text wale nishaan hain: O mean position, A aur B extreme positions, OC = x displacement aur OA = OB = x₀ amplitude. Ek vibration A se B aur wapas A tak hai, aur is mein lagne wala waqt T hai.

Amplitude (x₀): thartharati cheez ka mean position ke kisi bhi taraf sab se zyada (maximum) displacement amplitude kehlata hai; ise x₀ likhte hain. Fig. 14.1 mein pendulum ka amplitude OA ya OB hai: OA = OB = x₀.
Wave (lehar) ka amplitude batata hai ke wave kitni energy le ja rahi hai. Amplitude jitna bara, energy utni zyada; aur amplitude chhota to energy kam.

blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text:
Agar simple pendulum ka amplitude x₀ ho to
(i) ek cycle (vibration) mein pendulum kitna faasla tay karta hai?

blocks.prompt: Brain teaser ka jawab: amplitude x₀ ho to ek vibration mein bob kitna faasla tay karta hai?
blocks.explanation: 4x₀. A se O tak x₀, O se B tak x₀, phir B se O tak x₀ aur O se wapas A tak x₀: kul 4x₀.

blocks.text: Time period: ek vibration ya ek cycle poora karne mein jo waqt lagta hai use time period kehte hain. Ise T se likhte hain aur is ka SI unit second (s) hai.
Frequency f aur angular frequency ω ki madad se time period yun likhte hain:
Frequency: thartharati cheez ek second mein jitni vibrations (n) poori kare, woh us ki frequency hai. Ise f se likhte hain.
Frequency time period ka reciprocal (ulat, yani 1/T) hai:
Frequency ka unit hertz (Hz) hai. Ek hertz ka matlab hai ek second mein ek oscillation. Frequency ki dimension [T⁻¹] hai.
Angular frequency: ek second mein jitna angular displacement (angle mein ghoomna) ho, woh angular frequency hai. Ise ω (omega) se likhte hain:
Ek revolution (poora chakkar) mein θ = 2π radian aur waqt t = T (time period) hota hai.

blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text: Spring se bandhi ek machhli 20 second mein 10 vibrations karti hai. Is ka time period aur frequency kya hai?

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein yahan 'one revolution = 2 radian' chhapa hai; θ aur π ke nishaan chhapne se reh gaye hain. Sahi yeh hai ke ek chakkar mein θ = 2π radian hota hai; isi se agli equation ω = 2π/T banti hai.
Angular frequency ka SI unit rad s⁻¹ aur dimension [T⁻¹] hai.

blocks.prompt: Brain teaser ka jawab: 20 s mein 10 vibrations ho to T aur f kya hain?
blocks.explanation: T = kul waqt ÷ vibrations = 20 s ÷ 10 = 2 s. f = 1/T = 1/2 = 0.5 Hz (yani ek second mein aadhi vibration).

items: Oscillatory motion: mean position ke gird barabar waqt baad dohrane wali aage peeche harkat.
Vibration ek poora chakkar; x displacement; x₀ amplitude (sab se zyada displacement).
T = 1/f = 2π/ω; f = n/t (unit Hz); ω = θ/t = 2πf (unit rad s⁻¹).
